worldcombat.skill.bonerush.summary: Throw the hard bone in an arc again and again, slamming it into the ground under the target: the shock runs through the ground, so it is Ground damage and never contacts, and each landing rents the surface into cracks that fade on their own. The hammer form hits harder and reaches five strikes; the fissure form shakes wider and leaves longer scars.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.use.0: Throw the bone from a distance and slam it under the target
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.use.1: The landing shock heaves everyone in a small patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.use.2: Fissure form claims the field with lingering scars
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.description.0: Each strike is %1$s power (Ground, non-contact), up to %2$s strikes per string, each at %3$s accuracy; a target that walks away before the bone lands is missed.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.description.1: Throw range %1$s blocks, bone speed %2$s blocks/tick, arc drop %3$s, landing shock radius %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.description.2: Rent ground lasts %1$s, the last strike is x%2$s power; bone collision %3$s blocks, targets lifted %4$s blocks, %5$s between strikes, each strike kicking up about %6$s points of debris.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.fissure.on: Fissure form: x1.3 shock radius and x1.5 scar duration, so scars last longer and cover wider; the cost is x0.85 per strike, strikes capped at 3 and x0.92 bone speed.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.fissure.off: Hammer form: x1.15 per strike with up to 5 strikes, stacking single-target damage; the cost is x0.8 shock radius and shorter scars.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.timing: Range %1$s blocks, prepare %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.growth.0: At level %1$s, each strike rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.growth.1: At level %1$s, each strike %2$s and shock radius %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.growth.2: At level %1$s, each strike %2$s and last-strike multiplier %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.preference.fi: On (fissure): x1.3 shock radius and x1.5 scar duration, so scars last longer; the cost is x0.85 per strike, strikes capped at 3 and x0.92 bone speed. Off (hammer, native): x1.15 per strike with up to 5 strikes, stacking single-target damage; the cost is x0.8 shock radius and shorter scars.
worldcombat.skill.bonerush.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first instead of throwing bones. Higher values start from farther out.
On: throws more readily when other enemies stand near the target, since the landing shock covers a patch at once; off: ranks only by the ordinary attack order.
On: under a hold order it will still leave its post to throw bones; off: only casts when the target is already in range.
